canonical_identity.title: Language Atlas of India 1991
canonical_identity.corporate_author: Census of India / Office of the Registrar General, India
canonical_identity.scope: Mundari language distribution and speaker counts reported from the 1991 Census

manifestation_audited.canonicalization_rule: provider copies of the same Census atlas are manifestations, not independent corroborating sources

scope_and_uncertainty: Counts belong to 1991 Census geography and must not be silently mapped onto present-day Jharkhand district boundaries.
The atlas distinguishes Munda and Mundari entries; they must not be merged without an explicit linguistic/census mapping rule.
Reported script use and demographic counts are historical Census statements, not timeless cultural claims.
Search-indexed text is sufficient for identity/scope audit but exact page/map locators must be verified against the authoritative PDF before controlled evidence promotion.

rights_and_access.redistribution_permission: not established by discovery access alone
rights_and_access.cultural_access: no sensitive cultural content inferred from demographic tables

promotion.reason: Exact authoritative page/map locator, manifestation hash, and reuse terms have not yet been verified.

next_conversion_steps: Acquire/verify the authoritative Census manifestation and hash it where permitted.
Record exact printed page/PDF page and relevant map/table locator for the Mundari entry.
Preserve 1991 administrative geography explicitly in every derived evidence record.
Verify reuse terms before repository binary inclusion.
Promote only proposition-level demographic/script statements supported by exact locators.
